limitations: Benchmark gains do not capture all aspects of useful output quality.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI is rapidly approaching the top of its S-curve, after which progress will slow down dramatically.

statement.excerpt: AI fanatics are currently fantasizing over a world where they can put a few sentences into a prompt and create an entire series of TV, unable to realize that we are rapidly approaching the top of generative AI's S-curve, where after a period of rapid growth things begin to slow down dramatically.

from_speaker: the top of generative AI's S-curve
things begin to slow down dramatically
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that substantial capability improvements across generative AI will soon slow sharply.
Progress means demonstrated capabilities and useful output quality, not investment, adoption, or revenue.
Neither 'rapidly' nor 'dramatically' supplies a numerical threshold or calendar deadline. No deadline is added.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable longitudinal evaluations across major generative modalities establish a sustained, substantial slowdown relative to the preceding period of rapid improvement.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Broad, sustained capability gains would contradict a bounded near-term plateau prediction. Because no bound is supplied, continuing gains alone cannot conclusively refute this open-ended forecast.
